source_description: Fixed snapshot computed from PR #20's six-table job-analysis output, supplied as six_tables_split.zip, joining job family and qualifications by job_posting_id.
coverage_limitations: The timestamp is the aggregate calculation time, not the posting date range.
Posting first-seen dates and source URLs are unavailable in the supplied export; a 90-day or 180-day window cannot be verified.

The supplied export has no company field. Company coverage counts distinct companies among each role's analyzed postings in the team database on 2026-10-27, whose posting counts (2844 Software Engineer, 174 Data Analyst, 565 AI Engineer) differ slightly from this export.
Geographic coverage and cross-source duplicate postings cannot be independently verified from this export.
117 records without a supported job family were excluded; sample sizes are 2858 Software Engineer, 174 Data Analyst and 566 AI Engineer postings.
